remarks: Welcome to Looking Glass Estates a gated north Upland community of 57 homes located north of the 210 at Mountain Avenue. This three bedroom plus an extra room often used as an office, study or den offers this and so much more. The primary bath has a large oval tub with shower and  the hall bath has a shower in the tub. . Indoor laundryroom with side yard access. These are the Original owners. New paint for the interior. Some new interior lighting. It has an RV parking area. Community features are in ground pool, park and tennis court. I had the privilege of selling this entire track when they were built in 1988 Please don’t miss the opportunity to take show this lovely home.
